description_for_human: Governed context and execution for agents: an explicit SCW address space, a gate at every tool call and every model egress, and a hash-chained record of both.
description_for_model: Governed context and execution. Create and describe SCW windows, inspect the gate on an explicit SCW address, observe host-supplied context partitions, send gated model egress, and read the hash-chained containment record. Every tool call and every model egress is attributed to a window and attested.

auth.note: The live origin rejects unauthenticated tools/call with a role-'public' permission error; bearer is required for tool execution, not merely supported.
